notes.title: Working on quests and main story expansion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/ddec736899efd318e6da8f9fcc381024d26263a5.png[/img]

Working on quests and main story expansion continues.

New multi-missions menu is already developed for this purpose. New MISSIONS button will replace old MISSION and LOG buttons. Main quest log will be incorporated in Missions under "main quest" or "personal log" cathegory.

After some deliberation, I decided that the new missions menu will be based on buttons known from other menus (hyperpedia, inventory). From this menu, the player will be able to open a description of each mission currently undertaken and description of current main quest phase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/f2200ea3c30fdf60275d5c7d94cf5d428a75c373.png[/img]

The new menu is ready and is working in tests. Now comes the harder part:

- sort all old missions, add some new ones and attach everytning to this new menu.

- add more NPCs and questgivers with unique conversations in all cities, to make the game more alive.

- remake and expand the main story. The new story will be more rich and will start from planet 1. I already have it figured out in my head :]

notes.title: Increased spawns and smaller planets
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/9a84149299a28df7ebc740d6ec423aa727ae2202.png[/img]

This upgrade brings two important changes:

[b]- Increased enemy spawns[/b]

[b]- Smaller areas to explore on planets and moons.[/b]


All map stages on the surface have 3 spawn points. Every spawn point has now increased chance to generate enemies and resources from 50% to 80% (plus few % for some friendly NPC's, animals, crates).
There should be no more walking trough empty stages of the map.


Increasing the spawns alone would make exploring the surface even more slow, than it is now. Therefore almost all maps have been modified and explorable area has been reduced. Sometimes from 15 map stages to 10 or 8, sometimes from 8 to 4 or 3.

With increased spawns and reduced areas, exploration of planets and moons will go smoother. The ballance between space flight and surface walking should be more fair. The player will reach mission objectives or do other business faster and will be free to move on to the next place.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/81df773aa2435c4ac532e0ce9d9db2a7a61b6de2.png[/img]



Things to do next:

- Multi-quest journal + more quest, but they will be doable only 1 time.

- More NPCs on all planets to talk to (some of them will be questgivers for said new quest system)

- Better main quest. The story will be more or less the same, but should be expanded to form a truly epic adventure.

notes.title: Inventory system upgrade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/ffdecdf4afdb112ed9d0e70a767408bf001bf16d.png[/img]

- Further optimization of the code, for better performance of the game

- Inventory system upgrade: from now on, only items that the player owns will be visible. The other tiles in the list will be blanked out. Also added a small description of each page in the inventory, such as “weapons” or “minerals”. The new system should be less stinging to the eyes and will allow the player to better assess the possessions.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Future plans:

- I am thinking about a new quest system. All quests would only be done once from now on, but there would be more of them. I should also develop a multi-quest journal.

- I am thinking of expanding the main quest. More characters, more story.

- I might increase the spawns on the planets. Sometimes it feels a little empty.

- Some planets are perhaps too big. If I increased the spawns, the area of the planets could be reduced. The gameplay would be a lot smoother.

notes.title: New area looting system
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/055b2399de081bfcf2b449fe67081727b7eb5740.png[/img]

- Added new area looting system, designed to grab items from all nearby bodies. Just approach a fallen enemy, left click and relax- all items from closest area will float into your inventory. The sum of looted stuff will be displayed on small windows popping up. The old tri-item window is still active for crates.

- Conversation window should no longer open while other menu is already opened. This happened duing freeing of some prisoners.

- Space storm will no longer shoot lightning while the game is paused.

- When crossing the nebula, the blue cloud will be visible in ship interior mode too.

- The colours of Drathonians are now a little toned down from previous cartoonish blue. I am also thinking about recoloring or reanimating of some other creatures.

notes.title: Fix & optimalization pack
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/3a9f088c748fc8cf3a326b40bcc651d969f5e9f5.jpg[/img]

- Fixed some ore trader missions on Aradan and Teneria.
- Fixed bug in leveling system.
- Fixed hyperspace route from Uxari to Voltir.
- Deleted wind sound on some moons, where there should be no air and no winds.
- Camera in space should now work smoothly during speed boost and refuel. There was some small imperfection in its moves,
- Player ship Arantec Starseeker has now 16 000 max weight instead of 15 000. Its a little more expensive than Eclipse, so it should be tiny bit better at something.
- Reviewed and optimalized whole space combat system. Fixed some small glitches, like enemy ships crashing into asteroids without actual contact with asteroids.
- Strongest enemy ships have gained speed boost. Outrunning them will be very difficult if not impossible.


Next big thing to do will be some kind of area looting system on the surface. I think it is pointless to click every dead spider and collect every single vial of venom by hand. I will meditate on this mattter in the Temple of Sur Dan. Until then, take care, Hyperspacers!

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/bcdb4c2e46255bd9eb526236b00d82f25244d64d.png[/img]

- Hand weapons rebalance. The dmg of slow-firing weapons has been modified to make them more useful compared to faster weapons, such as gatling lasers. Slow weapons, like the Heavy Laser, are now almost as powerful and at the same time more economical because they use less ammunition. Plasma weapons are now even more distinctive from lasers, as they have a noticeably higher minimum dmg.

- There was albo a little bug with landing on planets during space combat. It was possible to accidentally press the landing button while holding left mouse button and shooting at enemy ships. This caused the player's ship to be paralyzed for 10 seconds for the duration of the landing. During this time, enemies continued to attack until the player landed. This is now fixed. To land, you have to stop shooting and then click the button.

notes.title: The great rebalance is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/8a45d07cf747c57774d12f0a80de0311c3f868b8.jpg[/img]

The purpose of this rebalancing is to improve the exploration of planets so that it doesn't take so terribly long compared to flying a spaceship. After the launch of the game, I received feedback from players, which prompted me to do some reworking.


-Right at the start, a new player receives a small text info, hinting at the goal of the game.
The player also gets a little more money, a few first aid kits, personal shields, stealth generators and hoverboards to test how they work.

- Hoverboards are cheaper and work longer. Hoverboards allow the player to go faster while exploring the planets and to better dodge enemy attacks.

- Medi kits are also a little cheaper and a little stronger. Level 1 heals 20 hp (with full survival skill + 80%=36 hp), level 5 heals 60 hp (with full survival skill 108 hp). Their price is determined by the resources used in production. Yes, you can make your own first aid kits when you buy a medical lab for your ship (you need a free utility slot). The cheapest way to heal is still food. But food is available from inventory when the game is not paused. First aid kits can be used faster during combat.

- Personal shields work the same way, but are now a bit cheaper. Since everything is getting cheaper, why not the shields?

- Stealth generators also work the same but are cheaper now.

- Loot from most enemies has been increased a bit

- Extractor now extracts more minerals from a single deposit.

- Scanner collects more scientific data from all objects. Objects that require scanner level 2 or higher will give even more data.

- All new spaceships are now half the price.

- All spaceship equipment is now half the price (ship weapons, engines, shields, utility devices).

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Things to do next:

- A journal showing info about current status of the main quest. This will take 1 or 2 days to make.

- Some kind of "Hyperpedia", a manual to explain complexities of the game mechanics to the players. This will take a little longer. I must meditate on it's formula, to make it as clunky and unnerving as possible ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Small fix and plans for the near future
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/26d2350c054b5d925e667b5acb5c9538e1709351.jpg[/img]

-   Today I'm throwing in a few small fixes. Among other things, the esc menu window should now pause the game.

-   In a few days I will do a some rebalance concerning mainly gameplay on planets. Item prices, the power of first-aid kits, working time of hoverboards and other such little things that should make the game a little more fluid.

-   I will start working on the in-game maual soon. This ,,Hyperpedia” should explain some of the complexities of the game's mechanics to new players, such as placing first aid kits and hoverboards on the quickitems bar and using them. 

-   I'm also thinking about adding a Log to explain the current status of the main quest. At the moment you can only figure it out from conversations.


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The rebalance is finished and will come live tomorrow, 07.06.2024
